checks.title: `make env-check` passes and `reports/env.md` exists
checks.threshold: env-check exit code 0 and reports/env.md present and non-empty
notes: note: env-check re-run by this gate; verify the timestamp in reports/env.md matches the gate run if you need the exact snapshot.

checks.title: Decoded settlements meet the minimum, and a random sample re-verifies on-chain
checks.measured: 9115 decoded settlements; re-checked 50 on-chain on existence, block, payer, seller, amount, nonce and relayer: 50 matched, 0 missing, 0 mismatched, 0 transport errors
checks.threshold: >= 1000 decoded settlements; 50 random rows re-checked via eth_getTransactionReceipt with 100% match

checks.title: Two independent sources agree on settlement count and total amount
checks.measured: 0 source(s) carry a measured cross-check window; 3 of 4 are usable at all (tenderly-public-rpc, thirdweb-public-rpc, cdp-x402-discovery)
checks.threshold: two independent sources, window 1h, both count and total amount within 2% relative difference
notes: FEWER THAN TWO USABLE SOURCES. Prompt Section 6 is explicit: if only one source works, G0.3 FAILS and a self-comparison must not be substituted. This is kill criterion #1 — report it to the owner rather than working around it.

checks.title: Unresolved token/mechanism share is within the cap, and everything is listed
checks.measured: 11 tokens; token share 0.1015%; mechanism share 0.0043% (1,438,413 EIP-3009 settlements vs 62 Permit2 proxy events in the same window)
checks.threshold: unresolved share <= 2%, every token listed explicitly

checks.title: Projected monthly cost is within budget, and terms and backfill projection exist
checks.threshold: projected monthly cost <= 0.0 USD, terms documented, projection present

checks.title: `docs/protocol_notes.md` cites enough real transactions, and ADR 0001 exists
checks.measured: 25 distinct transaction hashes cited (3 event topic hash(es) excluded)
checks.threshold: >= 20 distinct transaction hashes cited; ADR 0001 present

checks.title: Independent reviewer subagent ran with no unresolved findings
checks.threshold: the newest reports/review_*.md declares 0 unresolved findings
notes: unresolved findings count as FAIL (prompt rule 3.4.7). Resolve them or record why they are not resolvable.
